title: Lightly Lacquered Italian Pork Amatriciana
description: A cultured and tender Italian dish featuring pork, all purpose flour, and a lacquer glaze, perfect for a brunch mood. This high protein friendly dish is a variation of the traditional Amatriciana recipe.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a shallow dish, mix together the flour, salt, and black pepper.
Dredge the pork shoulder in the flour mixture, shaking off excess.
Heat a large skillet over medium high heat and cook the guanciale until crispy.
Remove the guanciale from the skillet and set aside.
Add the pork shoulder to the skillet and cook until browned on all sides.
Transfer the pork shoulder to a baking dish and brush with the lacquer glaze.
Bake the pork shoulder in the preheated oven for 20 minutes.
While the pork is cooking, cook the eggs in the same skillet used for the guanciale.
Slice the cooked pork shoulder and serve with the eggs, guanciale, and parmesan cheese.
Cook pork to an internal temperature of 63°C / 145°F, then rest 3 minutes before serving.
